# Links

A [site](https://example.com/page), a [fragment](#section), a
[fragment on a file](other.md#heading), a [file](other.md), a
[mail](mailto:someone@example.com) and `[code](not-a-link.md)`, a
[root link](/other.md) and a footnote[^1].

```text
[inside a fence](nope.md)
```

[reference]: other.md

[^1]: A footnote defines no target.
